content.text:
**Finding resubmitted: compliant** — no redline, no counterparty comment.

Repair made in this pass, addressing the verifier's accuracy note:
- Removed the specific characterisation of § 12.4 as a 24-month non-compete on Customer and the implicit assertion of a conflict with § 12.3. That tension belongs to the non-compete rule, and pre-judging it here risked stating a conclusion this rule has no mandate to reach.
- Replaced it with a neutral scope statement: restrictive covenants other than employee non-solicitation are reported under their own rules, and this finding does not resolve their scope or their interaction with § 12.3.
- Retained the substantive analysis the verifier accepted: the document-wide absence of any non-solicit, no-poach or no-hire covenant; § 12.3 running in our favour; and the explicit treatment of the two failed regex checks as non-probative because there is no covenant for them to measure.

Bottom line unchanged: NOSOLICIT sits at the **preferred** position, and § 12.3 benefits Meridian Fieldworks, so it is not flagged.
